title: When do good cars disappear?

controls.label: Share of good cars on offer

predict.q: Good cars are worth 10,000 to buyers (owners accept 8,000); poor cars 4,000 (owners accept 3,000). With half the cars good, what happens in the market?

options.fb: 7,000 is less than the 8,000 good-car owners accept, so they withdraw; then buyers know only poor cars remain.

options.s: Good cars sell at 8,000 and poor cars at 4,000
options.fb: Separate prices need buyers to tell the cars apart. They can't, so one price applies to all.

options.s: Good-car owners withdraw, and the price falls to at most 4,000
options.fb: Buyers offer 7,000, below the 8,000 good-car owners accept. Good cars leave, demand falls to D2 and only poor cars trade, at no more than 4,000.

options.s: The price rises to 10,000 as buyers compete for good cars
options.fb: Buyers won't pay 10,000 for a car that may be poor; competing harder does not reveal quality.

task: Move the share-of-good-cars slider and watch the buyers' offer and which cars are sold.

target.do: Move the share-of-good-cars slider, then press Check.

takeaway: Good cars sell only when at least two-thirds of cars on offer are good; below that, the market shrinks to poor cars.
explore: 60% → 7,600 and 65% → 7,900: still withdrawn. 70% → 8,200 and 80% → 8,800: good cars sell.
